name: U-Official
description: Does not attack but continuously restores the <@ba.kw>HP</> of all allies within range (the HP restored per second is equal to 10% of self ATK). This unit is unaffected by <$ba.inspire>Inspiration</>, and ignores the <@ba.kw>Deployment Limit</>, but has a long Redeployment Time.
